news.headline: Meerkats Are Great at Finding Their Way Home
news.body: Meerkats live in big family groups, but scientists found they are also expert solo travelers! Researchers put tiny GPS trackers on 20 meerkats in Africa's Kalahari Desert and let them go about a mile from home. 18 of them headed almost straight back. They often stood up on their back legs to look around first.

news.headline: Voyager 1 Is Now One Light-Day From Earth
news.body: The Voyager 1 spacecraft, launched in 1977, has reached a new milestone. It is now so far away that a beam of light takes a full day to reach it! On November 17, fans shone a flashlight Morse code message toward the sky for Voyager. It is the farthest spacecraft humans have ever made.

fun_fact: A group of meerkats is called a mob, and meerkat pups are babysat by the whole family! 🦡
